SELECT 
    s.store_id,
    s.store_name,
    s.region,
    s.store_type,
    ROUND(SUM(o.net_amount), 2) AS net_sales_usd
FROM retail_sales.orders AS o
JOIN retail_sales.stores AS s USING (store_id)
WHERE o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01' 
  AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01'
  AND s.store_id != 'WEB'
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, s.region, s.store_type
ORDER BY net_sales_usd DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH electronics_returns AS (
    SELECT 
        r.store_id,
        s.store_name,
        s.store_type,
        COUNT(*) AS return_count,
        SUM(r.returned_amount) AS total_returned_amount
    FROM retail_sales.returns AS r
    JOIN retail_sales.order_items AS oi ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
    JOIN retail_sales.products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN retail_sales.stores AS s ON r.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE r.returned_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01' 
      AND r.returned_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01'
      AND p.category = 'Electronics'
      AND r.condition = 'opened'
      AND s.store_type != 'ecommerce'
    GROUP BY r.store_id, s.store_name, s.store_type
)
SELECT store_id, store_name, store_type, return_count, total_returned_amount
FROM electronics_returns
ORDER BY return_count DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH enhanced_stores AS (
  SELECT 'S06' AS store_id UNION ALL
  SELECT 'S22' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'S16'
),
q3_returns AS (
  SELECT 
    r.store_id,
    COUNT(*) AS return_count,
    SUM(r.returned_amount) AS returned_value
  FROM retail_sales.returns r
  WHERE r.returned_at >= '2026-07-01' 
    AND r.returned_at < '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY r.store_id
),
enhanced AS (
  SELECT 
    qs.store_id,
    qs.return_count,
    qs.returned_value
  FROM q3_returns qs
  JOIN enhanced_stores es ON qs.store_id = es.store_id
),
chain_total AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(return_count) AS total_returns,
    SUM(returned_value) AS total_returned_value
  FROM q3_returns
)
SELECT 
  e.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  s.region,
  e.return_count,
  e.returned_value,
  ct.total_returns,
  ct.total_returned_value,
  (e.returned_value / ct.total_returned_value) * 100 AS pct_of_chain_value
FROM enhanced e
JOIN retail_sales.stores s ON e.store_id = s.store_id
CROSS JOIN chain_total ct
ORDER BY e.store_id;
